South Broward Wheelers Saturday Ride

Sunrise, FL

South Broward Wheelers Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Sunrise, FL. It meets every Saturday, 7:00 am, starting at Markham Park. Expect about 25–40 miles, 15–17 / 17–19 / 19–21 mph groups.

About the South Broward Wheelers Saturday Ride group ride

Club ride from Markham Park with three groups: intermediate, experienced and advanced. Routes go out on WhatsApp. Trial rides are welcome before you join.
